info.title: Multi-tenant API
info.description:
Schema-per-tenant REST API built with NestJS 12, Prisma 7 and PostgreSQL.

### Selecting a tenant

Tenant-scoped routes (`/t/**`, `/api-keys/**`) resolve the tenant from, in order of precedence:

1. `X-Tenant-Id` — tenant UUID, intended for service-to-service calls.
2. `X-Tenant-Slug` — business slug, e.g. `acme`.
3. The request subdomain, e.g. `acme.api.example.com`.

An API key never selects its own tenant: the tenant comes from the request,
and the key must belong to it.

### Authentication

| Caller | Credential | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Platform administrator | JWT access token | `POST /auth/sign-in` |
| Tenant member | JWT access token | `POST /t/auth/sign-in` |
| Machine | API key `mtb_<public>_<secret>` | any tenant-scoped route |

Access tokens live 15 minutes by default. Refresh tokens rotate on every use,
and replaying a rotated token revokes the whole session family.

### Security

- PII is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM; equality lookups use a keyed
  HMAC blind index, so no plaintext e-mail or phone number is ever queried.
- Responses and logs expose masked values unless a principal is asking for
  its own data.
- Raw SQL is restricted to parameterised tagged templates; dynamic
  identifiers must pass an allow-list before being quoted.
- Every tenant is isolated in its own PostgreSQL schema, addressed through a
  validated schema name.

schemaName.description: Physical PostgreSQL schema. Returned only on the detail endpoint.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Minutes east of UTC for the tenant timezone.

slug.description: Business slug. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; max 63 characters.

confirm.description: Must match the tenant slug exactly.

email.description: E-mail address of the platform administrator.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT for the Authorization header.

refreshToken.description: Long-lived refresh token; rotate on every use.

emailMasked.description: Masked e-mail of the authenticated principal.

mustChangePassword.description: Whether a password change is required before use.

mfaRequired.description: Whether the session must still verify (or enrol) a second factor.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token issued by the previous sign-in or refresh.

scopes.description: Subset of the grantable scopes. Wildcards other than `resource:*` are not allowed.

expiresAt.description: Absolute expiry. Defaults to API_KEY_DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS when omitted.

secret.description: Complete API key, returned exactly once. Store it now — only an Argon2id hash is persisted and it cannot be recovered.

ownerId.description: Required when the caller is an API key.

ErrorResponse.description: Every error response, whatever layer produced it (BN-REQ-API-002). See docs/ERRORS.md.

code.description: Stable discriminator; the only field a client should branch on.

parameters.description: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>">; two v1 values during a secret rotation.

parameters.name: X-MTBPay-Delivery
parameters.description: Signature scheme version.

eventId.description: Stable across retries; also sent as X-MTBPay-Event-Id. Deduplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the order changed, not when it was delivered.

sequence.description: Per order, strictly increasing. A gap means an event is still to come.

orderReference.description: Reference sent to Netpay as the merchant reference code.

amount.description: Amount with two decimals, as a string (e.g. "650.00").

refundedAmount.description: Total returned to the buyer so far.

refunded.description: Amount of this refund. Only on payment.refunded.

fullyRefunded.description: True once the whole amount went back.

data.description: The order at the moment of the change. No cardholder data of any kind.

schema.title: payment.expired
schema.description: Reconciliation found the order never paid in time: 3-D Secure not completed within 30 min, or a cash reference past its expiry (→ EXPIRED).

2XX.description: Accepted. Any other answer, or none within the timeout, is retried with backoff for 24 h.

post.description: Netpay reported a payment for an order already CANCELLED or EXPIRED. The status does not change (data.status is still CANCELLED or EXPIRED); data.netpayTransactionId is the payment. Refund it. JSON Schema: docs/events/payment.paid_after_cancel.schema.json.
